system.description:
Where Aura Perception offers glimpses of the spirit, Karmic Sight lets you gaze directly into a target's very soul.

The target must be within line of sight. Spend a Willpower Trait and make a Static Mental Challenge (difficulty equals the subject's Mental Traits) to learn their Nature, Demeanour, and whether they follow Humanity or a Path, and to detect influences on their mind or soul (Dominate, Entrancement, infernal pacts). A second Static Mental Challenge reveals their Willpower and Humanity/Path scores; a third reads the abstract state of their karma (and, at the Storyteller's discretion, fate-linked Merits or Flaws such as Destiny or Dark Fate). Retest with Investigation. Should you lose a challenge, you risk taking on one of the subject's derangements, a Psychological/Mental/Supernatural Flaw, or negative Traits for the rest of the session (subject's choice), and must begin the whole process again — including the Willpower — before proceeding.
